name: Accumulation
source:
Tanaka Shou is a man who recently started his adult life but was transferred to a branch only a week after joining the company.
No matter what he did, it never turned out well at the new office. He had no friends.
One day, he sent a hoax email to someone. The next morning he received a reply from a person named Sakaguchi Kazue.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ030775.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
田中翔是一位刚开始成年生活的男子，但入职仅一周就被调到分公司。
无论他做什么，在新办公室的结果都不太好。他没有朋友。
有一天，他向某人发送了一封恶作剧电子邮件。第二天早上，他收到了一个名叫坂口一惠的人的回复。

[编辑自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ030775.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
